title_zh: 克利奥帕特拉的“现代”距离
reveal_en: Cleopatra, the last pharaoh of Egypt, lived closer in time to the launch of the first iPhone in 2007 AD than she did to the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza, completed around 2560 BC.
reveal_zh: 埃及末代法老克利奥帕特拉生活的时代，距2007年iPhone发布的时间，比距吉萨大金字塔（约公元前2560年建成）建造的时间更近。
meaning_en: This reveals how vastly different durations can exist within our historical understanding, compressing and expanding the perceived past.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了我们历史认知中存在的巨大时间跨度差异，压缩与扩展了对过去的感知。

visual.motion: A slow, continuous scroll through a timeline, highlighting vast gaps and unexpected proximities.
